# Advokatas (Criminal Defense Attorney in Lithuania)

> Professional profile and legal practice information for a criminal defense attorney in Lithuania with over 45 years of experience.

## Overview

- **Specialization**: Criminal Law & Defense (Baudžiamoji teisė)
- **Practice Area**: Lithuania (In-person consultations in Vilnius and nationwide; remote consultations worldwide)
- **Experience**: 45+ years of legal practice
- **Supported Languages**: Lithuanian (lt), English (en), Russian (ru)
- **Consultation Formats**: Free initial phone evaluation (up to 15 min), in-person meetings, and online/video calls (Zoom, WhatsApp, Viber, Telegram)
